top_signals.title: Nippon Life Is Open to Becoming Net JGB Buyer Next Fiscal Year
top_signals.summary: Nippon Life Insurance Co., Japan’s largest life insurer, said it is open to becoming a net buyer of government bonds next fiscal year as it finds current interest rates attractive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
